display_information.name: Dice Companion
display_information.description: Dice rolls for Dungeons & Dragons games in Slack
display_information.long_description:
Dice Companion rolls dice for Dungeons & Dragons games in Slack. Its bot, Nat20, works in channels, threads and Huddle chats, and it is built for players who are new to the game.

How it works:
• Mention @Nat20 in a thread or a Huddle chat and it answers there with a dice picker. Choose the die, how many, your modifier and the type (normal, advantage, disadvantage or critical hit), then press Roll.
• Type /roll 1d20+5 attack to roll in a channel, /roll stats for a new character's ability scores, or /roll death for a death saving throw.
• More options adds a target number (DC or AC) that reports Success or Failure, a reason, or a secret roll only you can see.

Each roll shows the die tumbling for about a second, then the result with a picture of the face. A natural 20 is gold and a natural 1 is red. Several dice appear side by side, with every value and the total in the text. Only the newest roll in a thread keeps its picture and picker, and older rolls shrink to one line, so the conversation stays short.

Rolls come from a cryptographically secure random generator and are decided when you press the button.

Privacy: Nat20 answers only when you mention it, type /roll or press its buttons. It reads no channel history and stores no messages: it keeps only each person's message style (Beginner or Expert) and each workspace's installation. Permissions: app_mentions:read to hear its own mentions, chat:write to post rolls, commands for /roll, and reactions:write to celebrate a natural 20 or 1.
